doc_kind: Medicaid policy (Humana Healthy Horizons in Louisiana)
sections_in_order: Coverage Determination (Adults 18+, Pediatric 13-17, Revision, Panniculectomy After Bariatric Surgery)
criteria_location: Coverage Determination, pp.2-5: a shared preoperative-evaluation gate, then age-banded BMI/comorbidity criteria, revision, and a panniculectomy sub-policy.
procedures_covered: Bariatric surgery (procedures not enumerated; descriptions mention sleeve gastrectomy, RYGB, long-limb RYGB)

logic.top_level: all (shared gate) then pathways by age band
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: No exclusions list; 'Coverage Limitations: may NOT be eligible ... for any indication other than those above.' Pregnancy counseling is a requirement not exclusion.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Revision: 'Initial bariatric surgery requirements are met; OR Major surgical complication ... or its mechanical failure' with example list.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: BMI equal to or greater than 40 kg/m2, or more than 100 lbs overweight; OR BMI of greater or equal to 35 kg/m2 with one or more of the following comorbidities
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: An inline 'or' inside a bullet that is itself an OR branch; and 'poorly controlled hypertension (systolic ... greater than 140 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure 90 mm Hg or greater' has an unclosed parenthesis.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Any other comorbidity related to obesity that is determined by the preoperative evaluation to be improved by weight loss
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Catch-all makes the comorbidity list open and delegates judgment to the evaluator.

requirement_kinds.quote: Conducted by a multidisciplinary team including, at a minimum; A physician; AND Nutritionist OR dietician; AND A licensed qualified mental health professional
preoperative evaluation within the previous 12 months of the scheduled surgery
A determination that previous attempt(s) at weight loss have been unsuccessful and that future attempts, other than bariatric surgery, are not likely to be successful
A determination that the individual is capable of adhering to the post-surgery diet and follow-up care
counseling to avoid pregnancy preoperatively and for at least 12 months postoperatively
BMI of 30 to 34.9 kg/m2 with type 2 diabetes mellitus if hyperglycemia inadequately controlled despite optimal medical control
Obstructive sleep apnea confirmed on polysomnography with an AHI or RDI greater than or equal to 30
Individuals age 13 through 17 years old; under 13 case-by-case
The individual had bariatric surgery at least 18 months prior and the individual's weight has been stable for at least 6 months

thresholds.quote: BMI equal to or greater than 40 kg/m2, or more than 100 lbs overweight
BMI of greater or equal to 35 kg/m2 with one or more
BMI of 30 to 34.9 kg/m2 with type 2 diabetes
blood pressure greater than 140 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure 90 mm Hg or greater
AHI or RDI greater than or equal to 30
40 kg/m2 or 140% of the 95th percentile for age and sex, whichever is lower

time_windows.quote: within the previous 12 months of the scheduled surgery
at least 12 months postoperatively and until weight has stabilized
at least 18 months prior ... stable for at least 6 months

time_windows.what: Nonsurgical treatment for panniculectomy skin problems
time_windows.quote: failed to respond to at least 3 months of nonsurgical treatment
